Definition: from G4632; furniture, i.e. spare tackle:--tackling.
BiblicalUsage: Skeue is the tackling, the ship's gear, and it appears once, on the third day of the storm, when Paul's shipmates cast out the tackling of the ship with their own hands to lighten her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tackling went overboard because survival mattered more than cargo, and the storm strips a ship to what it cannot sail without.
